t: The Milwaukee Multi-Material Drill Bit Set offers a versatile solution for various drilling tasks across construction sites and workshops. This 8-piece hex shank drill bit set features durable tungsten carbide tips, ensuring reliable performance when drilling into wood, metal, masonry, plastic, and ceramic tiles. Ideal for electricians, plumbers, and general builders, the set includes sizes from 4mm to 10mm, providing flexibility and consistent results. It is suitable for use with 3-jaw and 1/4" hex chuck machines on rotary action, and comes with a PACKOUT compatible carry case for organised storage and transport.
b: Contents: 8 Multi-Material Drill Bits & PACKOUT Case.
Suitable for Wide Range of Building Materials, Ceramics & Tiles, Wood, Plastic, Thin Sheet Metals & Aluminium
